summary: Bollinger County, Missouri, 60-foot wooden lookout built 1947; removed in 2004, and the base remains on the state-managed Grassy Towersite.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: KRCU says a steel tower replaced the wooden Grassy tower in 1957-58. The state annual report quoted on the Weebly page says the steel tower replaced a temporary wooden tower at Flat Rock. The record does not count a 1957-58 replacement at Grassy, and the story says the sources disagree.

KRCU says the Missouri Department of Conservation dismantled the tower in 2004. The 2006 visit report says the state auctioned it and a buyer's four-person crew dismantled it by hand. Both can be partly true, so the story reports both.

notes_for_editor: The 2004 removal agrees across the register and KRCU, but who dismantled the tower differs (KRCU versus the 2006 visit report). KRCU's 1957-58 steel-tower replacement at Grassy is contradicted by the annual report quote naming Flat Rock, so the story leaves it as a disputed point. The register coordinates (37.2826, -90.0655) differ from the Central US lookouts list in the brief, about 0.6 km apart; I could not confirm the second figure on the page, so no coordinate conflict is recorded. A 'Moved' caption with a May 7, 2016 photo credit on the Weebly page is unexplained and not used. Current access rests on a 2025 article and a 2006 visit report; no current Missouri Department of Conservation access notice was checked. The brief's record has no errors I could confirm.
